editorial.blurb: Kraken Sushi & Beyond is a bustling, expansive Asian spot where fresh sushi, ramen, tempura, and curry come together with genuine warmth and creative cocktails in an intimate, thoughtfully lit setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation—this place fills up nightly—and grab a seat on the outdoor patio with its charming water feature if you can, or request one of the cozy tables with individual lamps that let you see your menu without disrupting the dim, convivial ambiance.
